dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge starting from the distal third of the fin, forming a high-degree falcate curve towards the dorsal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a narrow pixel radius; transition from leading to trailing edge is smooth without acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the visible horizontal body axis, exhibiting a slight convex bulge in the medial section.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-to-base width ratio of approximately 1.3:1 based on visible pixel extent.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple sets of parallel linear depigmented scars (rake marks) visible on the lateral flank below the dorsal fin; a minor irregular notch is present on the upper leading edge of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast bicolor demarcation between the dark dorsal cape and the light grey lateral field, with significant water droplet interference across the surface pixels.
